title: Extract fields from a PDF invoice

turns.prompt: Read the invoice PDF at {D}/invoice.pdf and write a JSON file {D}/invoice.json with keys invoice_number and total (the amount due, as a number). Then tell me both values.
turns.verify:
f={D}/invoice.json; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no invoice.json; exit 0; }; sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
d=json.load(open('{D}/invoice.json'))
num=str(d.get('invoice_number','')).strip()
tot=str(d.get('total','')).replace('USD','').replace('$','').replace(',','').strip()
ok = num=='INV-2026-0931' and abs(float(tot)-515.26)<0.01
print('PASS' if ok else f'FAIL: number={num} total={tot}')
EOF
